premises.text: Kids' play has shifted from physical social objects to isolating device-mediated digital play
premises.evidence_span: When we were kids, this is how it used to look like, playing with physical objects, playing together

premises.text: Tangible play blends board-game and video-game experiences using physical objects on a table with an iPad
premises.evidence_span: Imagine board games meet video games

premises.text: Hardware is a simple iPad accessory redirecting the front camera onto the play surface
premises.evidence_span: simple iPad accessory that redirects iPad's front camera to capture the surface in front of it

premises.text: Local AI software needs no Wi-Fi, no markers/QR on pieces, no calibration, and works under varied lighting in real time
premises.evidence_span: requires no marker QR code on game pieces. It runs in real time

premises.text: Sell physical games with companion apps at roughly $15–$30 game prices and under $30 base, aiming at the hybrid-games market
premises.evidence_span: we are targeting the price for the base less than $30

value.text: Restore social, magical real-world play through tangible hybrid games
value.evidence_span: One of the great thing about board games is they are inherently social

causal_links.evidence_span: board game experience as well as a video game experience
